_doc: Layer inventory for the Genome Atlas. Round 1 stubs all eight planned layers as not-yet-implemented entries so the engine can boot and the page1 [data-ga-layer] chips have a registry to look up. Each layer's `tier` / `source` / `path` is the COMMITTED contract per SCHEMA §28; the actual files don't exist yet — they ship from the cluster-side genome-annotation pipeline (phase B+).

_tier_legend.hot: RAM-pinned at trigger event; pages read state directly; <1ms
_tier_legend.warm: IndexedDB-cached at trigger event; first read async ~50ms; subsequent ~10ms

_round1_status: All eight layers are CONTRACT-ONLY (not-yet-loaded). page1's scaffold renders them as '⚪ not loaded' chips. Phase B turns on chromosome_map + gene_track + repeat_track; later phases turn on the rest.

assembly_stats._feeds: page1 chromosome overview · QC banner (phase B)

gene_track._feeds: gene cargo per inversion · functional context (phase B/C)

repeat_track._feeds: TE landscape · breakpoint repeat enrichment (phase B)

synteny_blocks._feeds: collinearity vs related Siluriformes · ancestral karyotype (phase D)

centromere_telomere._feeds: centromere bands · T2T completeness chip (phase B)
